Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can know the square numbers up to 10 × 10

✓ I can use the order of operations (brackets, × ÷, then + −)

✓ I can write one sum for a real-life problem

So you can check the till, split the bill and carpet a room!

🏠 Menu

♟️ Chessboard

A chessboard is 8 squares by 8 squares. Your mate guesses 16.

How many little squares are on it?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

One row

8 squares

Step 2

8 rows of 8

8 × 8 = 8² = 64

64 squares. Checkmate, mate! ♟️
